name: ListDisposeStrategy

parameters.help_en: ID of the security orchestration and automated response disposal strategy
parameters.help_zh: 安全编排与自动化响应处置策略ID
parameters.name: sophon_task_id

parameters.help_en: Entity feature value. Use this to perform a fuzzy search on entities
parameters.help_zh: 实体特征值，可以对处置实体进行模糊搜索
parameters.name: entity_identity

parameters.help_en:
Entity type. Valid values:

- ip

- process

- file
parameters.help_zh:
实体类型。取值：
- ip：ip
- process：进程
- file：文件
parameters.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en:
Playbook type. Valid values:

- system: manual disposal

- custom: event-triggered playbook

- custom\_alert: alert-triggered playbook

- soar-manual: manually run playbook

- soar-mdr: MDR-run playbook
parameters.help_zh:
剧本类型。取值：
- system：手动处置
- custom：事件触发剧本
- custom_alert：告警触发剧本
- soar-manual：手动运行剧本
- soar-mdr：MDR运行剧本
parameters.name: playbook_types

parameters.help_en:
Strategy status. Valid values:

- 0: disabled

- 1: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
策略状态。取值：
- 0：失效
- 1：有效
parameters.name: effective_status

parameters.help_en:
Sort field. Valid values:

- GmtModified: sort by last modified time

- GmtCreate: sort by creation time

- FinishTime: sort by strategy end time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。取值：
- GmtModified：按更新时间排序
- GmtCreate：按创建时间排序
- FinishTime：按策略结束时间排序
parameters.name: order_field

parameters.help_en:
Sort order. Valid values:

- desc: descending

- asc: ascending
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值：
- desc：降序排列
- asc：升序排列
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: Start time of the query, in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，单位毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: End time of the query, in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，单位毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Current page number. Must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 列表当前页号，大于等于1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: Number of entries per page. Maximum value is 100
parameters.help_zh: 列表每页条数，最大不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
View type. Valid values:

- 0: view for the current Alibaba Cloud account

- 1: view for all accounts under the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: Alibaba Cloud account ID when an administrator switches to another member's perspective
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
Location of the Data Management center for Threat Analysis and Response. Select the location based on where your assets are deployed. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: assets in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China)

- ap-southeast-1: assets outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析与响应的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
